### Institutions: ^1^Department of Pathology, Microbiology, and Immunology, University of South Carolina School of Medicine, Columbia, SC 29209, USA; ^2^ Department of Drug Discovery and Biomedical Sciences, College of Pharmacy, University of South Carolina, Columbia, SC, 29208, USA
### Corresponding Author: ^*^Mitzi Nagarkatti, Ph.D., Basic Science Bldg. 1, Rm C-26, Columbia, SC, 29209, USA
Figure Code for Reproducibility

**Note:** The processed Seurat objects and V(D)J table used for downstream analysis are available through the associated data repository. These include:

- `integrated.RDS`: integrated Seurat object containing all cells across conditions
- `cd3_pos.RDS`: CD3e+ T cell subset generated from the integrated object
- `vdj_all.RDS`: combined V(D)J annotation table

The code below documents the full figure production workflow associated with this manuscript.

```{r}
set.seed(0311)
```

## Figure 3

### Figure 3A
```{r}
integrated <- readRDS(file = "integrated.RDS")
```

```{r}
#loading unannotated RDS object
integrated1 <- integrated
Idents(integrated1) <- integrated1$seurat_clusters
#numeric cluster names
numeric_cluster_ids <- Idents(integrated1)
#annotate clusters
truncated.cluster.ids <- c(
  "0" = "AECs", 
  "1" = "nCD8+ TC",
  "2" = "BC", 
  "3" = "NK", 
  "4" = "aCD8+ TC",
  "5" = "iMac",
  "6" = "AM",
  "7" = "Neut", 
  "8" = "aCD4+ TC",
  "9" = "QECs",
  "10" = "iMono",
  "11" = "pCD8+ TC",
  "12" = "ncMono",
  "13" = "Fib", 
  "14" = "cDC1s", 
  "15" = "Aero",
  "16" = "pDCs",
  "17" = "RECs")

names(truncated.cluster.ids) <- levels(integrated1)
integrated1 <- RenameIdents(integrated1, truncated.cluster.ids)

# Save the original cluster names
original.cluster.names <- Idents(integrated1)

# Assign numerical cluster identities for plotting
integrated1 <- SetIdent(integrated1, value = numeric_cluster_ids)

# Create a data frame for custom legend
custom_legend <- data.frame(
  cluster_number = as.numeric(names(truncated.cluster.ids)),
  cluster_name = truncated.cluster.ids,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# UMAP plot
umap1 <- DimPlot(integrated1, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 1, ncol = 4, label = TRUE, label.size = 5, repel = TRUE, split.by = "stim") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(integrated1@meta.data$seurat_clusters))),
    labels = paste(custom_legend$cluster_number, ":", custom_legend$cluster_name)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5),ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))

# Restore the original cluster identities
integrated1 <- SetIdent(integrated1, value = original.cluster.names)

# Plot with custom legend
print(umap1)
```

### Figure 3B
```{r}
univADTfeatures <- c("Ms.CD45","HuMs.CD11b","Ms.CD31","Ms.CD19","Ms.CD3","Ms.CD86","Ms.Ly.6G","Ms.CD4","Ms.CD8b")

DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "ADT"

FeaturePlot(
  integrated, 
  features = univADTfeatures, 
  max.cutoff = 75, 
  ncol=3) &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  )
```


### Figure 3C
```{r}
marker_genes <- c("Pecam1", "Vegfa", "Cd8a", "Lef1", "Cd19", "Cd79a", "Ncr1", "Klrd1", "Cd8b1", "Cd69", "Ccl2", "Fcgr1", "Siglecf", "Itgax", "Ly6g", "S100a8",
"Icos", "Cd4", "Cdh5", "Cd34", "Cd14", "Vcan", "Mki67", "Ezh2", "Nr4a1", "Treml4", "Col1a1", "Sparc", "Alcam", "H2-Eb1", "Aqp1", "Plvap", "Siglech", "Tcf4", "Postn", "Epas1")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "RNA"
integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, features = marker_genes)
```

```{r}
DoHeatmap(integrated, features = marker_genes, size = 0, label = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"),
    name = "Z-Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )+
  ggtitle("Marker Gene Expression Across Clusters")
```

### Figure 3D
```{r}
# Convert table to dataframe
pt <- table(Idents(integrated), integrated$stim)
pt <- as.data.frame(pt)

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(pt) <- c("CellType", "Condition", "Count")

# Ensure proper factor levels for desired order
pt$CellType <- factor(pt$CellType, levels = desired_order)

# Calculate percentages within each Condition
pt <- pt %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count) * 100)

# Create a separate pie chart for each condition with percentages
condition_labels <- c("C57BL/6J+VEH" = "C57BL/6J+VEH",
                      "C57BL/6J+SEB" = "C57BL/6J+SEB",
                      "C3H/HeJ+VEH" = "C3H/HeJ+VEH",
                      "C3H/HeJ+SEB" = "C3H/HeJ+SEB")

ggplot(pt, aes(x = "", y = Percentage, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "black") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~Condition, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(Condition = condition_labels)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "black")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors)
```


### Figure 3E
```{r}
legend_df <- table(Idents(integrated), integrated$stim) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(c("CellType", "Condition", "Count")) %>%
  mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, levels = desired_order)) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(Condition, "C57BL/6J+VEH" = "C57BL/6J+VEH",
                      "C57BL/6J+SEB" = "C57BL/6J+SEB",
                      "C3H/HeJ+VEH" = "C3H/HeJ+VEH",
                      "C3H/HeJ+SEB" = "C3H/HeJ+SEB"),
    Percentage = round(Percentage, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(CellType, Condition, Percentage)

# Pivot to wide format and add colors
legend_wide <- legend_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = Percentage) %>%
  mutate(Color = cluster_colors[as.character(CellType)]) %>%
  relocate(Color, .before = CellType)

# Generate GT Table
legend_wide %>%
  gt() %>%
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(Color)),
    fn = function(x) {
      glue("<div style='background-color:{x};width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:3px'></div>")
    }
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Color = "",
    CellType = "Cell Type",
    `C57BL/6J+VEH` = "BL6+VEH %",
    `C57BL/6J+SEB` = "BL6+SEB %",
    `C3H/HeJ+VEH` = "C3H+VEH %",
    `C3H/HeJ+SEB` = "C3H+SEB %"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = "CellType") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(`C57BL/6J+VEH`, `C57BL/6J+SEB`, `C3H/HeJ+VEH`, `C3H/HeJ+SEB`)) %>%  
  fmt_number(columns = c(`C57BL/6J+VEH`, `C57BL/6J+SEB`, `C3H/HeJ+VEH`, `C3H/HeJ+SEB`), decimals = 1) %>%
  opt_table_font(font = list(
    google_font("Roboto"),
    default_fonts()
  )) %>%
  tab_style(  
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_style( style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  cols_width(
  Color ~ px(30),
  CellType ~ px(90),
  `C57BL/6J+VEH` ~ px(100),
  `C57BL/6J+SEB` ~ px(100),
  `C3H/HeJ+VEH` ~ px(100),
  `C3H/HeJ+SEB` ~ px(100)
) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(16),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )
```


### Figure 3F
```{r}
# A list of cell cycle markers, from Tirosh et al, 2015, is loaded with Seurat.  We can
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
```

```{r}
library(gprofiler2)
mmus_s = gorth(s.genes, source_organism = "hsapiens", target_organism = "mmusculus")$ortholog_name
mmus_g2m = gorth(g2m.genes, source_organism = "hsapiens", target_organism = "mmusculus")$ortholog_name
```

```{r}
integrated <- CellCycleScoring(integrated, s.features = mmus_s, g2m.features = mmus_g2m, set.ident = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Idents(integrated) <- integrated$Phase
```

```{r}
DimPlot(integrated, split.by = "stim", ncol = 2, pt.size = 1) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),  
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(6, 2, 2, 2), "pt")) &
        plot_layout(guides = "collect")&
        plot_annotation(
        title = "Cell Cycle Scores",
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  )
```


## Figure 4

### Figure 4A

```{r}
#loading unannotated RDS object
cd3_pos <- readRDS(file = "cd3_pos.RDS")
#numeric cluster names
Idents(cd3_pos) <- cd3_pos$seurat_clusters
numeric_cluster_ids <- Idents(cd3_pos)
#annotate clusters
new.cluster.ids <- c(
  "0" = "nCD8+", 
  "1" = "aCD8+",
  "2" = "aCD4+", 
  "3" = "CD4+ CM", 
  "4" = "pCD8+",
  "5" = "TCR Vβ8+ CD8+", 
  "6" = "eCD8+"
  )
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(cd3_pos)
cd3_pos <- RenameIdents(cd3_pos, new.cluster.ids)

# Save the original cluster names
original.cluster.names <- Idents(cd3_pos)

# Assign numerical cluster identities for plotting
cd3_pos <- SetIdent(cd3_pos, value = numeric_cluster_ids)

# Create a data frame for custom legend
custom_legend <- data.frame(
  cluster_number = as.numeric(names(new.cluster.ids)),
  cluster_name = new.cluster.ids,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# UMAP plot
umap1 <- DimPlot(cd3_pos, reduction = "umap", split.by = "stim", pt.size = 1, ncol = 4, label = TRUE, label.size = 5, repel = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(cd3_pos@meta.data$seurat_clusters))),
    labels = paste(custom_legend$cluster_number, ":", custom_legend$cluster_name)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5),ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))

# Restore the original cluster identities
cd3_pos <- SetIdent(cd3_pos, value = original.cluster.names)

# Plot with custom legend
print(umap1)
```

### Figure 4E
```{r}
# Ensure barcodes in vdj_all match those in cd3_pos

vdj_all <- readRDS(file = "vdj_all.RDS")

vdj_filtered <- vdj_all[vdj_all$barcode %in% colnames(cd3_pos), ]

# Count v_gene usage by sample_id
v_gene_counts <- vdj_filtered %>%
  group_by(sample_id, v_gene) %>%
  tally() %>%
  ungroup()

# Select top 10 v_genes per stim
top_v_genes <- v_gene_counts %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(v_gene) %>%
  unique()

# Filter to top v_genes
v_gene_counts_top <- v_gene_counts %>%
  filter(v_gene %in% top_v_genes)

# Reshape for heatmap
heatmap_matrix <- v_gene_counts_top %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set v_gene as rownames
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$v_gene
heatmap_matrix$v_gene <- NULL

heatmap_matrix <- select(heatmap_matrix, "BL6_VEH", "BL6_SEB", "C3H_VEH", "C3H_SEB")
heatmap_matrix <- rename(heatmap_matrix, 
                         "BL6+VEH" = "BL6_VEH", 
                         "BL6+SEB" = "BL6_SEB", 
                         "C3H+VEH" = "C3H_VEH", 
                         "C3H+SEB" = "C3H_SEB")

# Plot heatmap
pheatmap::pheatmap(as.matrix(heatmap_matrix),
                   cluster_rows = F,
                   cluster_cols = F,
                   color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue"))(100),
                   main = "Top V Genes",
                   fontsize = 16,                 
                   fontsize_row = 14,             
                   fontsize_col = 14,             
                   angle_col = 0)

```

### Figure 4F
```{r}
# Define Vβ8 family gene names
vb8_genes <- c("TRBV13-1","TRBV13-2","TRBV13-3")

# Detect TRBV13-x even in combined v_gene strings
vdj_all$TRBV13_subfamily <- sapply(vdj_all$v_gene, function(v) {
  any(sapply(vb8_genes, function(target) grepl(target, v)))
})

# Merge with Seurat metadata
# Create a named vector from vdj_all$TRBV13_subfamily with barcodes as names
TRBV13_vec <- setNames(vdj_all$TRBV13_subfamily, vdj_all$barcode)

# Subset to common barcodes
common_barcodes <- intersect(Cells(cd3_pos), names(TRBV13_vec))

# Assign using named vector indexing
cd3_pos$TRBV13_subfamily <- FALSE  
cd3_pos$TRBV13_subfamily[common_barcodes] <- TRBV13_vec[common_barcodes]

# Convert remaining NAs to FALSE
cd3_pos$TRBV13_subfamily[is.na(cd3_pos$TRBV13_subfamily)] <- FALSE
```


```{r}
# Plot UMAP
DimPlot(cd3_pos, group.by = "TRBV13_subfamily", 
        split.by = "stim",
        cols = c("gray", "red"), 
        pt.size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Cells Expressing TRBV13-1/2/3") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r}
# Define Vβ3 family gene names

vdj_all$TRBV26_subfamily <- sapply(vdj_all$v_gene, function(v) {
  any(sapply(vb3_genes, function(target) grepl(target, v)))
})

TRBV26_vec <- setNames(vdj_all$TRBV26_subfamily, vdj_all$barcode)
```
